subject: Pocket Cucco
text: The Pocket Cucco hatches overnight after obtaining the Pocket Egg from the woman in Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote: After speaking to the woman in Kakariko...wait overnight and it will hatch.

subject: Pocket Egg
text: As Adult Link, speak to the woman beside the chicken coop in Kakariko Village to receive the Pocket Egg.

evidence.quote: As Adult Link, head to Kakariko Village...and speak to the woman beside the chicken...coop and she will give you this item.

subject: Prescription
text: Link receives the Prescription from Biggoron on top of Death Mountain by bringing him the Broken Goron's Sword.

evidence.quote: You will get this from the Biggoron on...top of Death Mountain if you bring him...the Broken Goron's Sword originally.

subject: Purple Rupee
text: Collecting a Purple Rupee adds fifty Rupees to Link's total accumulated Rupees.

evidence.quote: adds to your total accumulated Rupees,...this particular one gives fifty Rupees..

subject: Red Rupee
text: Collecting a Red Rupee adds twenty Rupees to Link's total accumulated Rupees.

evidence.quote: adds to your total accumulated Rupees,...this particular one gives twenty Rupees.

subject: Shadow Medallion
text: After completing the Shadow Temple, Impa entrusts the Shadow Medallion to Link in the chamber.

evidence.quote: After completing the Shadow Temple then...and Impa will entrust this to Link.

subject: Silver Gauntlets
text: Young Link finds the Silver Gauntlets as the primary target in the Spirit Temple.

evidence.quote: You will find these in the Spirit Temple...as Young Link, they are your primary...target when going through the temple.

subject: Silver Gauntlets
text: As an Adult, the Silver Gauntlets allow Link to push and pull extremely large objects with his bare hands.

evidence.quote: As an Adult, the Silver Gauntlets allow...you to push and pull extremely large...objects with your bare hands alone.

subject: Silver Rupee
text: Collecting Silver Rupees awards five Rupees and acts as a means to open locked doors.

evidence.quote: Not only do they give you five Rupees...means to open locked doors as well.

subject: Silver Scale
text: The Silver Scale is won in Zora's Domain by playing the Diving Game found down the tunnel to the left of the king.

evidence.quote: In Zora's Domain, go up to the king...find the Diving Game where you win it.

subject: Silver Scale
text: The Silver Scale extends Link's diving time from the normal 3 seconds to a total of 6 seconds.

evidence.quote: Instead of the normal three seconds, this...scale allows you to dive deeper under...the water for a total of six seconds.

subject: Skull Mask
text: Link can borrow the Skull Mask from the Happy Mask Shop after acquiring all three Spiritual Stones.

evidence.quote: After you have acquiried all three of...the Spiritual Stones, head back to the...Happy Mask shop and borrow this one.

subject: Skull Mask
text: Give the Skull Mask to the Skull Kid found by taking a left turn at the first fork in The Lost Woods.

evidence.quote: Give it to the Skull Kid in The Lost...Woods, the one you find when you...make a left turn at the first fork.

subject: Spirit Medallion
text: After completing the Spirit Temple, Link appears in the chamber and receives the Spirit Medallion from Nabooru.

evidence.quote: After completing the Spirit Temple then...and the Gerudo gives this to you.

subject: Spooky Mask
text: Bring the Spooky Mask to the Kakariko Village Graveyard during the day and give it to the kid impersonating Dampe.

evidence.quote: Take it to the Kakariko Village Graveyard...during the day and give it to the kid...wandering around impersonating Dampe.

subject: Stone of Agony
text: Return to the house in Kakariko Village after collecting 20 Gold Skulltula tokens to receive the Stone of Agony.

evidence.quote: When you have collected 20 Gold Skulltula...tokens, return to Kakariko Village...and get this as a reward from the house.

subject: Stone of Agony
text: The Stone of Agony sends a rumble signal to the controller whenever a secret is nearby.

evidence.quote: This special item will send a rumble...signal to your controller whenever...there is some sort of secret nearby.

subject: Water Medallion
text: After completing the Water Temple, Ruto entrusts the Water Medallion to Link in the chamber.

evidence.quote: After completing the Water Temple then...and Ruto will entrust this to Link.

subject: Weird Egg
text: Malon gives Link the Weird Egg at Hyrule Castle past the Market when Link agrees to help wake up her father.

evidence.quote: Malon gives it to you when you agree...to go and help wake up her father...after the Market at the Hyrule Castle.

subject: World's Finest Eye Drops
text: Bring the Eyeball Frog to the research laboratory in Lake Hylia to receive the World's Finest Eye Drops.

evidence.quote: Bring the Eyeball Frog to the research...laboratory in Lake Hylia and the guy...there will give you this item for it.
